lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is irregular, with a wider gap in the mid-posterior region between lines 6 and 7.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, 7, and 10 (ordered anterior to posterior) are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral fringe or the dorsal line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two distinct high-contrast circular spots visible on the upper posterior flank/haunch region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral lyrate silhouette; vectors initiate with a dorsal-lateral flare and terminate with a medial-upward convergence.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The terminal 10% of the horn length exhibits a distinct transition to high-luminance ivory pixels.

other_distinctive_markers: White V-shaped chevron on the nasal bridge, two distinct white spots on the lower cheek, and a dark ventral fringe extending from the throat to the lower belly.
